# Lemonnade V3 (L3) design system

> React + TypeScript components and design tokens for Lemonn, CS Pro and Kuber — mobile-first trading apps. Build UI only from these components and `--l3-*` tokens; read the rules first.

Human docs: https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonnade-v3-docs/ · Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/lxQ6QIXGOv5mmx0khh5sJn/ · Everything in one file: llms-full.txt

## Rules

- [Instructions for AI agents](agent-docs/agents.md): Read first. Workflow, non-negotiable rules and how to verify a screen.
- [Figma → code map](agent-docs/figma-code-map.md): How every Figma component and property maps to a React component and prop.
- [Design system rules](agent-docs/design-system.md): Spacing, layout, tokens, typography, components, states, accessibility, theming, Do/Don't.
- [Design language (fintech)](agent-docs/design-language.md): How L3 screens look and read: principles, numbers, colour meaning, archetypes, the quality bar every generated screen is scored on.
- [Learnings](agent-docs/learnings.md): Dated lessons from real runs (what was slow or wrong, the number, the fix). Read before repeating a task.
- [Playbook: migrate, audit, extend, generate](agent-docs/playbook.md): Algorithms + tools: find a component, audit code/Figma, migrate old designs, swap components without moving layout, create components, generate screens.

## Foundations

- [Colors](agent-docs/colors.md): How Lemonnade color works: semantic tokens by role, the 13 accent families, component tokens and the base palette — for all 10 themes (5 brands × modes, plus ♿ Accessible).
- [Typography](agent-docs/typography.md): Manrope in three roles — Heading (750), Label (650) and Description (500) — 20 text styles, each a single font token.
- [Spacing & radius](agent-docs/spacing.md): Spacing, radius, size and icon-size tokens from the Figma "🌌 Number" and "Icon size" collections.
- [Layout](agent-docs/layout.md): How a screen is spaced: 16 page padding, sections 24 apart (32 for a bigger break), 16 from a section heading to its card, and 12 inside every card.
- [Icons](agent-docs/icons.md): The full Material Symbols set — Rounded, weight 400, grade 0, optical size 24dp, fill off (with the filled variant). Search, copy as SVG or download any icon.
- [Brand logo](agent-docs/brand-logo.md): The Lemonn, Zing and Coinswitch logos: full (mark + wordmark) or just the mark, at 24–48px high.
- [Color tokens](agent-docs/color-tokens.md): All semantic color tokens with values per theme.
- [Typography tokens](agent-docs/typography-tokens.md): Every text style: Heading (750), Label (650) and Description (500).
- [Spacing, radius & size tokens](agent-docs/spacing-tokens.md): Spacing, radius, size and icon-size values.

## Components · Action

- [Button](agent-docs/button.md): Buttons let people take an action, confirm a choice or move forward in a flow.
- [Button dock](agent-docs/button-group.md): A bar at the bottom of a screen or sheet that holds its main actions — stacked full-width, or side by side.

## Components · Input & control

- [Checkbox & radio](agent-docs/checkbox.md): Checkboxes pick any number of options; radios pick exactly one from a group.
- [Input field & text box](agent-docs/text-field.md): Fields let people enter text — a single line (input field) or several lines with a character counter (text box).
- [Toggle switch](agent-docs/switch.md): Switches turn a single setting on or off, and take effect immediately.
- [Stepper](agent-docs/stepper.md): A number with − and + buttons, for quantity and lots in the order pad.
- [Select](agent-docs/select.md): An inline trigger — a label and an icon — that opens a sheet of options.
- [Date picker](agent-docs/date-picker.md): A month calendar for picking one day or a date range.

## Components · Navigation

- [Tabs](agent-docs/tabs.md): Tabs switch between related views on the same screen. Underline tabs split a page into sections, pill tabs filter what's shown, and a pill group switches how content is shown.
- [Actionbar](agent-docs/actionbar.md): The bar at the top of a screen: back, the screen title with an optional description, and up to a couple of actions — or a search field.
- [Bottom navbar](agent-docs/bottom-navbar.md): The tab bar at the bottom of the app for moving between its main sections. Mutual Fund and F&O have their own sub-navs with a Home item back to the main bar.

## Components · Surfaces

- [Card](agent-docs/card.md): A surface that groups related content. Clickable cards are one tap target; static cards just show information.
- [Bottom sheet](agent-docs/bottom-sheet.md): A panel that slides over the screen to show a focused task — confirm an order, pick an option, see a result — without leaving the page.
- [Overlay](agent-docs/overlay.md): The dimmed backdrop behind a bottom sheet or any other modal.

## Components · Feedback & status

- [Aerobar & toast](agent-docs/aerobar.md): A short status message with an optional action — inline as a full-width bar, or floating as a toast after something happens.
- [Empty state](agent-docs/empty-state.md): What to show when a search or list has nothing in it: an illustration, a short heading and hint, and a way forward.
- [Skeleton](agent-docs/skeleton.md): A grey placeholder that mirrors the layout while content loads.
- [Progress bar](agent-docs/progress-bar.md): Shows how much of something is used or done, or where a value sits in a range.

## Components · Data display

- [List cell](agent-docs/list-cell.md): A row in a list: an icon, a label with an optional description, and something on the right — a chevron, a switch, a tag or a value.
- [Tag](agent-docs/tag.md): Tags label, categorise or show the status of something in a compact form.
- [Section header](agent-docs/section-header.md): The heading row of a section: a title, with an optional tag, info icon, short description and one action — View all or a switcher.
- [Price change](agent-docs/price-change.md): A signed change — price, P&L or returns — in green when up and red when down.
- [Chart](agent-docs/chart.md): Price charts — candles, line or area — and a small sparkline for lists.
